text.tspan: What happens on kubectl apply (steps match the notes)
filter → score → bind to a node
sandbox → CNI gives IP → pull → start
11 · Ready → EndpointSlice updated → kube-proxy rules on every node
kubectl apply returns as soon as step 5 is done. Steps 6–11 happen afterwards, asynchronously.
Watch them live: kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp -w
